cohort: Term pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: While intrathecal opioids did not impact breastfeeding rates, infant weight at two months was lower in the spinal opioid group.
mod_finding: Spinal (intrathecal) opioids do not have any impact on breastfeeding.
birth_weight: Not mentioned but assumed to be normal as study focused on term pregnancies
